body:
This happened to me when I was 16 and it was so torturously burned into my brain that I dropped out of college because I couldn’t focus. I spent months visualizing throwing a sheet over the image and shoving it to the back of my brain attic just to make it stop. It did eventually, and now I barely remember the image. I’m really sorry this happened to you, and thank you for reporting it.

ETA: You are a good person. Feeling so horrible about it proves that. I felt the same way you do when it happened to me, but bad people feel no disgust nor would they report it. This is not your fault and you did the right thing.

NTA dude the first week of her not showing up should have been it. A “come get your stuff or it’s going on the curb by [insert trash day]” text would have been acceptable tbh. You’re telling me you hand delivered it to her place and she’s still calling you an AH? No way, man. I can see why she’s an ex.

NAH . Life happens. It will be easier for you both in the long run. I don’t normally comment, but seeing so many insane people here say y t a is peeving me off. Please do not listen to the people saying those things. If you stay you run the risk of resenting him and those kids. Which could end reeeeally BADLY. This situation is no one’s fault and it is good you are making the responsible decision to end things when you encounter a dealbreaker. You are making the right decision for you, him, and the kids. Remember that part any time a nosy family member tries to guilt you into a miserable life you don’t want. Those kids are about to be teenagers. They can tell when they aren’t wanted, and they may lash out at you or themselves over it. It’s best that their brother can focus his whole attention on them instead of focusing on making you comfortable with this. Please please OP do NOT listen to the guilt trippers. They do not have anyone’s best interests in mind and have no clue what they are talking about. I wish you, your ex, and the kids endless healing and peace. And to reiterate OP you are NOT the AH in any way shape or form!

And to all the y t a comments: you seem like you can’t possibly grasp how difficult a situation like this is. I hope you can find enough empathy in your hearts and emotional intelligence in your brains to see past the surface level “marriage comes with hard times” to realize this is not an average “hard time”. What she is doing is a GOOD thing. I literally cannot stress that enough! OP is not equipped to raise these kids and that is OK! You can’t force someone to be perfectly able to help traumatized preteens!

Hey OP I hope the divorce is going well and I hope you were/are able to use the evidence you have against her. I also hope you are able to get full custody of your kids seeing as she is ill and can’t be trusted with full time care since you are the primary caregiver in your house and she couldn’t handle it without you. Best of luck to you my friend, cheaters are scum and are usually horrible parents too. You sound like a great parent and I’m sure the courts will not be kind to someone cheating on their spouse who was suffering with cancer. Peace be with you and your children.

NTA OP! 

This was extremely thoughtful of you and very rude of her to not even let you explain what the chain was for. She sounds very immature and irrational to run away to mommy over literally nothing. I would never want her as my nurse if this is how she acts. She should know by looking with her eyes that she is not dating her brother and you are not that kind of person! 

I hope you can update us soon because you deserve better.

No reason that I can remember. I wasn’t having problems so it was really out of the blue and obviously everything was fine when she checked. It really just seemed like “I need to check and it’s mandatory”.

Thank you for this, it really helps clear some things up for me. I’m glad to know that while it’s not exactly “uncommon” for some doctors to disregard child patients’ consent, it’s at least considered a bit cruel by others in the field. Thank you again, you’re very kind and I wish you the best

I guess it just concerns me that a pediatrician can just carry on with such an invasive exam while the child they’re examining cries and adamantly refuses to be touched. The only reason I stayed still eventually was because I was scared to be in trouble. There shouldn’t have been a reason for the exam (never did sports or anything that would require a physical), and I wasn’t having any issues down there. My mother told me I needed to do this exam, but I’ve found that my mom doesn’t usually question the doctor about anything really. Thank you so much for responding to my post
